name: Mods for Patchbay (updated 15 Nov 2026)
body:
> **Pre-release document.** Written by Claude for early testers.

**Disclaimer: these mods are not affiliated with Bitwig Studio or Bitwig GmbH.**

Every mod for [Patchbay Mod Loader](https://github.com/shaboogen-dev/Patchbay/releases), one ZIP each. They need Patchbay 0.36.0-dev.13 or newer, which ships the frameworks they build on.

## Updated 15 Nov 2026

- **Panel: Mix Map 0.2.0-dev.2:** Drum Machine pads and Instrument/FX Layer chains show as their own dots under their track.
- **Browser: Pre-5.0 Style Side Browser 0.2.0-dev.1:** the view works again with the frameworks in Patchbay 0.36.0-dev.13 and newer.
- **New, by Polarity: Piano Roll: Scale Fold** (a piano roll showing only the current scale's pitches) **and Piano Roll: Step Sequencer** (a 16-step sequencer in the Detail Editor).
- **Full mods ZIP updated** with all of these.

## Every mod at once

**Full mods ZIP updated 15 Nov 2026:** `all-mods-2026-11-15.zip` holds every mod below. With Patchbay closed, unpack it into the `mods` folder of your Patchbay install, then open Patchbay, tick the mods you want and click **Load**. (Add Mod… takes one mod per ZIP, so use the single ZIPs below with it.)

## Installing

1. Download the ZIPs you want. Don't unpack them.
2. In Patchbay, go to **Mods** and click **Add Mod…** (or drag the ZIPs onto the window). Several at once is fine.
3. Tick them and click **Load**.

To update a mod, add its newer ZIP the same way: Patchbay asks first, and its tick and settings stay. A mod marked "needs" in the table also needs the mod named there; Patchbay lists it under **Errors** until you add it.

These are tester builds. Each mod's README (the **README** button in Patchbay) says what it does.
